title: sedum cespitosum var. andegavense
intro:
Sedum cespitosum var. andegavense, commonly known as the Andegavense stonecrop, is a plant species in the Sedum genus, characterized by its succulent leaves and stems. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Sedum cespitosum var. andegavense include wound healing, skin protection, and the treatment of various skin conditions due to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects on human health.

Note: There is limited information available about the health benefits, therapeutic actions, and bioactive constituents of Sedum cespitosum var. andegavense.
